guide.lunar_horizons.title: Lunar Horizons Handbook
guide.lunar_horizons.page.0.title: Expedition handbook
guide.lunar_horizons.page.0.body:
Welcome to Lunar Horizons!
Bases: pages 2–9. Machines: 10–18. Diagrams: 19–22. Recipes: from page 23.
Use section buttons, page arrows and scroll buttons.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.1.title: First habitat
guide.lunar_horizons.page.1.body:
1. Build a sealed room from solid blocks.
2. Stack two airlocks vertically.
3. Connect a solar panel, battery and oxygen generator using power cables.
4. Load ice and close the airlock.
5. Check the HUD: oxygen tanks are not consumed in a sealed habitat.
Tablet: right-click flat ground, select a project and press Build. Survival requires actual blocks. Supply power and ingredients separately.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.2.title: Electricity
guide.lunar_horizons.page.2.body:
Solar: regular 30 E/s, advanced 90, damaged 8. Requires open sky. Daytime on Earth; constant sunlight is simulated on the Moon.
Cables connect adjacent faces. A switch breaks the circuit. A sealed feedthrough carries power through a wall.
Grid limit: 1024 elements.
Thin power wire works like cable and connects to it and machines. Use a sealed feedthrough in walls.
Power cables and wires run near the bottom of the block and touch the solar panel frame. Connecting above a panel creates a vertical terminal.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.3.title: Atmosphere and pipes
guide.lunar_horizons.page.3.body:
Room limit: 2048 cells and 24 blocks per axis from the player.
Place an O2 generator in the room or connect it to a wall vent via pipes (512 network elements max).
Thin pipes do not seal wall holes. Open airlocks and breaches remove protection.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.4.title: Machine controls
guide.lunar_horizons.page.4.body:
Right-click empty-handed to open a console. Right-click ingredients to load one; sneak-click for a stack.
Buttons load inventory, collect product and toggle power.
The status line explains idle conditions. Help opens the machine's page.
Input: 64 max; output: 32 max.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.5.title: Production automation
guide.lunar_horizons.page.5.body:
Place a chest or barrel directly above the machine for ingredients and another directly below for output.
Enable Auto. Transfers up to one item per second in each direction.
Refill charges stay inside the station; refill tanks manually. Double chests are treated as individual halves.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.6.title: Example power grid
guide.lunar_horizons.page.6.body:
Two regular panels = 60 E/s. O2 generator and two lamps use 36 E/s; remaining 24 E/s charges batteries.
Add panels for a refinery (45 E/s). Oxygen and lighting have priority.
Check switches and the grid terminal.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.7.title: Rocket and rover
guide.lunar_horizons.page.7.body:
Rocket: right-click fuel to fill tank (8 max), empty hand to board. R starts, cancels countdown or aborts ascent before dimension transfer.
Rover: power cell adds 600 E; park near an enabled battery for up to 60 E/s. WASD to drive, Space to brake. Wear a spacesuit.
Mk II: rocket has 16 fuel, 3 s countdown and faster flight. Rover has 10800 E, up to 12.4 m/s, parked solar charging 15 E/s and base charging 120 E/s. Open cabin.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.8.title: Troubleshooting
guide.lunar_horizons.page.8.body:
Check open sky, face-connected cables, switches, ingredients, battery charge and free output space.
No oxygen? Close airlocks, fix holes, check ice, power and pipe-to-vent connections.
Networks operate only in loaded chunks.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.9.title: Batteries
guide.lunar_horizons.page.9.body: Standard: 3600 E; industrial: 14400 E. Connect to cables or a panel. Excess charges batteries; shortages draw from them. Disable to isolate the battery. Charge is lost when broken.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.10.title: Helium generator
guide.lunar_horizons.page.10.body: Helium-3 → 120 E/s. One unit per 60 seconds of operation. Runs on demand or to charge batteries. Auto: helium above.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.11.title: Oxygen generator
guide.lunar_horizons.page.11.body: Lunar or regular ice. Uses 20 E/s; one ice lasts 120 seconds of operation. Place inside a sealed room or pipe to a vent. Auto: ice above.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.12.title: Electric refinery
guide.lunar_horizons.page.12.body: Raw titanium → titanium ingot. 45 E/s, 6 seconds per item. Auto: input above, ingots below.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.13.title: Fuel synthesizer
guide.lunar_horizons.page.13.body: Helium-3 → rocket fuel. 60 E/s, 10 seconds per item. Auto: helium above, fuel below.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.14.title: Electric refill station
guide.lunar_horizons.page.14.body: Ice → internal refill charge. 25 E/s, 5 seconds per charge. Right-click a depleted tank or press Refill to restore it. Auto: ice above.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.15.title: Powered lamp
guide.lunar_horizons.page.15.body: Uses 8 E/s. Light level 15 when powered. No ingredients required. Connect directly or via cable.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.16.title: Power terminal
guide.lunar_horizons.page.16.body: Shows generation, served load, demand, total storage and node count. Served below demand means some machines lack power. The terminal consumes no energy.
guide.lunar_horizons.page.17.title: Industrial assembler
guide.lunar_horizons.page.17.body: Titanium ingot → control circuit. 50 E/s, 8 seconds per item. Auto: titanium above, circuits below.
